item.title: Casey Wasserman selling his talent agency amid Epstein fallout
item.description: Casey Wasserman is selling his talent agency amid backlash over his ties to Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Cleanup underway after tree fell on oil pipeline valve, causing 150-gallon oil spill: Officials
item.description: County officials said the oil did not reach nearby homes or bodies of water and only extended about 10 feet from the plant's fence line. First responders placed containment booms around the site to prevent further spread.

item.title: Father shot by son while working on bike in Kingwood-area home garage, Houston police say
item.description: Houston police said the man was in his garage shed working on his bike when he was shot in the neck, turning around to see his son with a gun in his hand.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the US with more surgeries to come, team official tells AP
item.description: The chief of the U.S. Ski Team says Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the United States a week after her terrifying head-over-heels crash in the Olympic downhill.

item.title: Crews seen working on NRG Stadium roof after water pours into venue during event, video shows
item.description: According to officials, the NRG park area was hit with 48 mph winds and rainfall totaling 0.40 inches in a 10-minute period. It's unclear whether Saturday's storms caused new damage or exposed existing vulnerabilities.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins NASCAR Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.

item.title: Spectacular weather in Houston for Presidents' Day, big warm up coming ahead of next front
item.description: We've got some fantastic weather to enjoy the next few days before sea fog and minor rain chances return ahead of our next front.

item.title: Community protests demolition of historic Garden Oaks Theater
item.description: Nearly five years after preservationists helped save the historic River Oaks Theatre from demolition, a new battle is underway--and this time it's in Garden Oaks.

item.title: Suspect charged with capital murder after firefighters find man shot to death in NW Houston: HPD
item.description: The Houston Police Department said that a man has been charged with capital murder after firefighters found a man gunned down in northwest Houston.
